item.description:
Lincoln 1.0.3

Lincoln 1.0.3 moves diagnostics out of the editor into a Get Info window.

  • Get Info (⌘I, also in the tunnel's … menu): a window per tunnel with the live status — state, control master pid, socket path and whether terminal sessions share it, forwards inherited from ssh config, last check and launch — plus the exact commands: the control master command, the terminal session command and the ssh_config snippet, each with a copy button.
  • Leaner editor: the Status and Command preview sections and the reconnect help text are gone from the Configure form.
  • … menu and Tunnel menu: Copy ssh Command (⇧⌘C) and Copy ssh_config Snippet live there now; the header button is removed.

Lincoln 1.0.2

Lincoln 1.0.2 trims the main window toolbar to the one action that belongs there.

  • Simpler toolbar: Only New Tunnel remains in the window toolbar. Diagnostic Logs are reached from Window ▸ Logs (⌥⌘L) and the menu bar extra.
  • File ▸ Import from ssh config… (⇧⌘I) opens the import sheet; the empty-state button still offers it on first run.

Lincoln 1.0.1

Lincoln 1.0.1 keeps Terminal.app as the console and stops duplicating it inside the app.

  • Copy ssh Command: The Terminal button and menu item are replaced by Copy ssh Command (⇧⌘C) in the tunnel header and the Tunnel menu. It copies an ssh command for your own terminal that opens a session on the host through the tunnel's control master, so no second Duo prompt is needed; the same command is shown under Status.
